attributes.name: Fihralaz
attributes.powers:
Fihralaz is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. If you succeed at an Intelligence or Knowledge 9 check, or if your check has the Attack or Ranged trait, add 3 to the check to defeat Fihralaz.

Before you act, each other character at your location summons and encounters the henchman Demonling.

If undefeated, end your turn.
